title: Held-out examples by omission
situation: The operator, 2026-10-15, confirmed after two read-backs: the workflow becomes intent-based delegation instead of a prescribed procedure. Held-out examples were withheld from work packages.
decision: Held-out examples are withheld by omission: kept with the design, never named in any task a builder receives, and given only to reviewers. No mechanism prevents reading them and no instruction forbids it, because a prohibition would announce them. When one fails, builders learn the concept and the shortfall, never the case.
consequences: Tasks never reference held-out examples; that is the only discipline required.
